chart.description: Chart name if using helm charts or full url if using CRI image chart.

config.description: Config is the list of configuration options for the feature.

dependsOn.description: DependsOn defines the features that this feature depends on.

environmentKinds.description: EnvironmentKinds is the list of environments this feature can be used in.

mapping.description: Mapping is the list of mappings from environment values for the feature.

repo.description: Repo is the repository where the helm chart is located.

source.description: Source should be the URL to the helm chart source code.

timeout.description: Timeout is the amount of time helm should wait for the feature to be ready. Defaults to 5m0s
